runs.stdout:
sni_hosts listed {{'tlsv1.3',[{dNSName,"other.example"}]},
                  [{sni_hostname,"other.example"}]}
sni_hosts default {{'tlsv1.3',[{dNSName,"localhost"}]},
                   [{sni_hostname,"localhost"}]}
sni_hosts unlisted {{'tlsv1.3',[{dNSName,"localhost"}]},
                    [{sni_hostname,"unlisted.example"}]}
sni_hosts trailing dot {{error,{tls_alert,unrecognized_name}},
                        {error,{tls_alert,unrecognized_name}}}
sni_hosts no name {{'tlsv1.3',[{dNSName,"localhost"}]},[]}
sni_fun options {{'tlsv1.2',[{dNSName,"other.example"}]},
                 [{sni_hostname,"other.example"}]}
sni_fun undefined {{'tlsv1.3',[{dNSName,"localhost"}]},
                   [{sni_hostname,"localhost"}]}
sni_fun unrecognized {{error,{tls_alert,unrecognized_name}},
                      {error,{tls_alert,unrecognized_name}}}
sni_fun names ["localhost","other.example","unknown.example"]
server option errors [{error,{options,{sni_hosts,[]}}},
                      {error,{options,{sni_hosts,[{"x",[]}]}}},
                      {error,{options,{sni_hosts,other}}},
                      {error,{options,{sni_hosts,{[],[]}}}},
                      {error,{options,{sni_hosts,other}}},
                      {error,{options,{sni_fun,{'fun',2}}}},
                      {error,{options,incompatible,[sni_fun,sni_hosts]}},
                      {error,{option,client_only,server_name_indication}}]
client option errors [{error,{option,server_only,sni_fun}},
                      {error,{option,server_only,sni_hosts}},
                      {error,{options,{server_name_indication,other}}}]
ssl_sni: ok
